text: Bank of Baroda's loans grew eighteen percent. Here's what the headline hides.
Global loans, fifteen point one two lakh crore. Minus loans in India, eleven point eight eight lakh crore. That leaves three point two four lakh crore abroad.
It grew forty percent in a year. Loans in India grew thirteen and a half.
So twenty one percent of the book delivered thirty nine percent of the growth.
And it's not just Baroda. P N B's overseas loans grew sixty three percent. So where is the growth really coming from? Back to the napkin.
